name: Bravo Software FZ-LLC
profile:
350 million people in 22 countries speak Arabic, it is the language of all online and print media in these countries, it is the language of business, all official correspondence, poetry, the arts and more.   
 
Spoken Arabic however is quite different from what is learned at school. While spoken Arabic has its roots in classical (Fusha) Arabic, it is different enough to pose a considerable challenge to learners of classical Arabic, simply put, we are teaching our students a language that they do not actually use in everyday life!   
 
BravoBravo is a mobile and web app designed to reach the new generation of students (increasingly immersed in technology) and to allow them to learn the all-so-important classical Arabic. 
 
BravoBravo is a learning tool like no other; it is a gamified, adaptive, interactive, fun and visually rich learning and assessment application that will take the user experience to a whole new level. This is a game changer.   
 
The deep level of engagement and the breadth of the content expose the students to a great amount new vocabulary. Data captured is presented as detailed analytics ranging from the individual learner to the district/country level.     
 
BravoBravo streamlines school assessment and is a live evaluation tool. The system is home to a huge database of questions that are all skill based and is suitable for all Arabic curricula, questions are presented to students as a game that is available on all smart devices, each question has easy, medium and hard levels of difficulty. BravoBravo offers a web dashboard for school administrators, teachers and parents. 
 The covered subjects are Arabic and Mathematics for grades 1 to 4. Data is collected from the students’ performance while playing the game (answering questions) and is presented using portals and dashboards to different stakeholders. The game is adaptive automatically generating harder and easier questions based on the students’ performance.  
BravoBravo is ideal for monitoring student progress and identifying areas of strengths and weaknesses. With a focus on Arabic, BravoBravo sets itself apart in the landscape of learning applications and gives all educational institutions the freedom to adapt their curricula and teach Arabic in a more appealing manner. It frees up hundreds of assignment and homework preparation hours so teachers can focus more on the learning process inside the classroom, teachers do not have to change their lesson plans to use BravoBravo.
